name: Sakura
source:
"Baths aren't something you take every day.”

A member of the supernatural disaster response team of a secret government organization.
She is naive, extremely troublesome, and shy.
She is unable to do anything on her own except fight, so she needs nursing care.

She eats a lot, so her food costs 1 million yen.
